# Approve -> dispatch -> receive (WS2B)

*Generated by `npm run rehearse:dispatch`. Do not edit by hand.*

Run 2026-09-13T20:02:49.143Z against `http://localhost:3100`, in a real browser.

| | |
|---|---|
| Order | SC Katihar-02 (Katihar) -> SC Purnia-08 (Purnia) |
| Item | Td Vaccine (Tetanus + Diphtheria) |
| Planned | 11 doses |
| An approve with no session | refused, 401 |
| Countersigned by | operator · rehearsal donor district officer |
| The countersigner approving it themselves | refused, 409 four eyes |
| Approval re-scored both ends in | 14 ms |
| Receiver, PROJECTED at the full quantity | P(out) 100% -> 3% |
| Dispatched | 11 doses (donor 30 -> 19) |
| Received | 8 doses |
| Variance | 3 doses short on arrival |
| Receiver, ACTUAL | 3 -> 11, P(out) 100% -> 22% |

The last two rows are the point. The plan said the receiver would reach 3%; it reached 22%, because
the risk recovered by what ARRIVED and not by what was sent. A system that could not
represent that gap would be describing a supply chain nobody works in.
